name: Widget for Elementor for Astra Theme
author: sflwa

sections.description: When using the WP Astra theme, there are page specific instructions regarding the container, the sidebar and some additional elements. When using the Elementor page builder with Astra, you need to switch back-and-forth in order to update the settings. This plug-in adds a widget that allows you to adjust the settings within an element. The widget can be removed from the Page after you save your settings if you wish.
